name: mxc-sandbox
description: Run the Claude Code CLI inside a Microsoft MXC sandbox on Windows for isolated testing of prompts, plugins, skills, hooks, and untrusted repos. Bundles a .NET host (Microsoft.Mxc.Sdk) with three modes: probe the host, run headless claude in a filesystem- and network-scoped ProcessContainer, or run interactive claude in an IsolationSession. Includes setup, run, interactive, and troubleshooting skills built from verified host behaviour. Windows 11 only.
